input.brief: Saku: mobile money notebook, white with emerald from the wallet logo, one obvious next action and progressively revealed planning

style.name: Pastel consumer
style.basis: 2 screens: a wallet home and a personal finance home
style.idea: Categories are coded by pale tints whose ink is the dark of the same hue, all under one large radius, and each headline sum sits inside the card that explains it.
style.colourBudget: 5-8%, as pale tiles and data marks

font.note: Money at 24-32px; card titles regular; semibold for net worth, bill amounts and actions.

style.signature: Pale category tiles with the dark of their own hue as ink (#dcf1ff with #0a3a80), one large radius (20px on cards, stepping down to 10, 8 and 5 inside), and quiet money polarity: income green with a plus sign, spending in ink, no red on ordinary outgoings. Tints go on small tiles, avatars and chips; a panel that holds a list stays white. When the product has people (two partners, a family), each gets one hue, at least 60 degrees from the next.
identity: The tile hues from the account's own colours (the card's colour, each pot's colour in the app) in place of the dealt cobalt, each tile pale with the dark of its own hue as ink.
The money's own objects: the card art at its real ratio, merchant marks at 24px in the rows, the goal's picture on its pot.
Manrope's figures carry the balance: 30-36px at 600 with tabular figures and the pence in a smaller grey, so the number itself is the face.
avoid: two data palettes on one page (flagged in the study)
a 624px phone-width column on a desktop screen (flagged as a stretched phone screen)
a KPI strip on top: the sums belong in their cards
whole panels tinted per person or category beside white cards (two surface languages on one screen)
style.notes: The two studied screens used a pure #0000ff and an indigo #4723f5 as their brand colour, and pastels such as #7cbecf that fall under 3:1 on white. The library uses a cobalt that reads as blue rather than indigo, and data colours darkened to at least 3:1 on the card.

shell.name: Open plane

numbers.sidebarWidth: 230-256 (230, 240, 256 in the study; 280 and 292 with a built-in icon rail)
numbers.separation: none, or one 1px hairline; the sidebar sits on the page ground or within 1-2% of it
numbers.activeItem: neutral grey pill, radius 6-12, inset 8-12px from the sidebar edges (#e9e9e9-#ededed)
numbers.canvas: fluid with a 24-64px gutter, or a centred 1100px column

shell.blueprint: The labelled sidebar sits on the page ground with nothing or one hairline between it and the canvas; there is no top bar, and the page header and cards sit straight on the ground about 32-36px from the top. Workspace or account switcher at the top of the sidebar, primary nav on a 34px pitch, groups under 12-13px sentence-case grey labels with 22-56px of air above, utilities and the user row pushed to the bottom. Cards are white on the off-white ground (or the sidebar is white with a 1px border on a #f9fafb canvas). The canvas is fluid with one gutter value, or a centred column for personal homes.
shell.phone: The sidebar folds into a 48px top bar holding the screen's name, a menu button that opens a full-screen sheet with the nav and the switcher, and at most one action. Content takes the full width with 16px margins.

pattern.name: Finance home with a pinned accounts column
pattern.blueprint: No page header and no KPI strip: cards start 36px from the top and each headline sum sits in the card that explains it. On the left, a 306px accounts card pinned at the viewport height minus the 36px margins opens with net worth (16/600 label left, value right) and holds the account tree with no dividers: groups 16px ink, categories 14px ink, leaves 14px grey indented 8px, values right-aligned, a 30px pitch and about 45px between groups; an empty group is a bordered box with an '+ Add account' link instead of $0.00. On the right, a 2-column grid with 24px gaps of cards that answer this month's questions, each with its own period caption: the plan (spanning both columns; a ring with an empty hole, a dot legend, the available figure beside it with a per-day line), recent spending as 61px two-line rows (payee over category, amount over date, right-aligned) and upcoming bills. Income is green with a plus sign; spending stays in ink.
pattern.phone: Net worth becomes the first card; the account tree collapses to its groups with totals; the month cards stack.

pattern.name: Balance, actions and assets
pattern.blueprint: One column whose every element snaps to its two edges. A balance card (1px border, 16px radius, about 134px tall) holding one 32px figure and one line under it in which only the change is coloured ('-$0.09 in the last 30 days'); the title says what the figure is, so it needs no label. 32px below, 4 equal action tiles in a pale tint with dark same-hue icon and 12-14px label (4 x 144 + 3 x 16 = 624 in the study; scale the column and keep the arithmetic). 32-40px below, text tabs for the asset kinds on a 1px rule with a 2px ink indicator as wide as the word, a network or account select on the right of the same row. Then the asset table: 72px rows (48px round icon plus 24px), no dividers, two-line cells pairing a 16px value with a 14px grey unit amount, numeric columns right-aligned to shared edges, change as a small solid triangle and a coloured percentage, zero change grey, a missing share a grey em dash. On a desktop do not leave the column at phone width: the study's 624px column was flagged as a stretched phone screen; widen it to 864-1100 or give it a second column.
pattern.phone: This pattern is phone-first: the same column at full width with 16px margins, the 4 tiles in one row, the table as two-line rows with the value right-aligned.

pattern.name: Settings in two columns
pattern.basis: one settings page; stacking from a narrow rail card. The basis is thin.
pattern.blueprint: A centred column of about 1152px. Each section is one row: a label column of about 450px (16/500 title, 14px grey description; the title's cap top 6-8px below the panel top, level with the panel's first line) beside a panel of about 700px with a #fafafa fill, 16px radius, 16px padding, no border and no shadow. Sections are split by a full-width 1px rule with 32px above and below. Inside a panel: field labels 14/500 above 40px white inputs (1px #e8e8e8, radius 10), 8px from label to field, 16px between fields, 24px from the description to the first label, 16px to the Save button; switch rows with a 14/500 title, a 20px status badge 8px after it, a 14px grey description and a 28x16 toggle 16px from the right edge, centred on the title line. A plan-gated feature shows a 48px tinted strip with a 32px button directly above its panel, and the panel stays readable. When a panel runs much taller than its label, put the section's help or a summary of the current values in the label column rather than 250px of nothing.
pattern.phone: Each section stacks: title and description, then the panel at full width. Inside, label, 8-10px, field, 16-26px to the next pair; toggles stay on the right of their title.
